constitution.amend: proposed by the Supreme Assembly or by referendum; passage requires two-thirds majority vote of both houses of the Assembly or passage in a referendum

courts.highest: Supreme Court (consists of 67 judges organized into administrative, civil, criminal, and economic sections); Constitutional Court (consists of 7 judges)
courts.judges: judges of the highest courts nominated by the president and confirmed by the Senate of the Oliy Majlis; judges appointed for a single 10-year term; the court chairman and deputies appointed for 10-year terms without the right to reelection. (Article 132 of the constitution)
courts.lower: regional, district, city, and town courts

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Uzbekistan

world: has not submitted an ICJ jurisdiction declaration; non-party state to the ICCt
